operational.quote_row_id: required for automatic eligibility; must be non-missing and unique within the batch
operational.currency: required for automatic eligibility; must be explicitly MXN
operational.realized_cost_mxn: optional evaluation label; stripped before every predictor and never returned

invariants: protected_cost_mxn >= central_prediction_mxn for every finite prediction
guardrail_reasons is a JSON array string
unknown or non-MXN currency cannot be auto eligible
missing or duplicate quote_row_id cannot be auto eligible; row_id index fallback is shadow-only
component failure must abstain and must not raise a quote decision
realized_cost_mxn is never an inference feature
an unfitted calibrator contributes zero adjustment and cannot be auto eligible

calibration.required_training_predictions: out-of-fold, point-in-time and strictly before untouched holdout
